data.description:
Today one active lease anywhere blocks the entire pull. Replace that with a
per-knot filter: apply every remote event except those for knots this machine
currently holds a lease on.

Why the filter is one-sided. A lease on a *remote* machine is not a reason to
skip that knot locally — applying its events is read-only visibility into
someone else's in-flight work, and `is_stale_precondition`
(src/sync/apply_helpers.rs:327) already drops events whose `profile_etag` no
longer matches. The only knots that need holding back are the ones a local
agent is mid-action on, so it sees a stable state for the duration of its
claim. No intersection of local and remote lease sets is required.

The real obstacle is the watermark. `apply_to_head` writes
`last_index_head_commit` and `last_full_head_commit` = target_head after the
pass (src/sync/apply.rs:108-111), and `changed_files` diffs forward from there.
Skipping a knot's events while the watermark advances loses those events
permanently — strictly worse than deferring the sync.

Fix with a quarantine table rather than per-knot watermarks:
- When knot K's event at head H is skipped because K is locally leased, record
  `(knot_id, base_commit)` once, using the pre-pass watermark as base_commit.
- On a later pull, for each quarantined knot no longer locally leased, run
  `git diff --name-only <base_commit>..HEAD` scoped to that knot's events,
  apply them, and drop the row.
- Event ids are UUIDv7, so path sort order is time order and replay stays
  correctly ordered.

Depends on the lease-ownership knot: "leased by this machine" is only
expressible once leases record an owner.

Note (do not fix here): `skipped_unknown_workflow_knots` (src/sync/apply.rs:227)
has the same watermark hazard — it is an in-memory set discarded at end of
pass, so a knot skipped for an uninstalled workflow is never re-applied after
the workflow is installed. The quarantine table is the natural home for that
fix; file it as a follow-up once this lands.

Scope:
- Quarantine table + migration.
- Local-lease knot-id set (knots bound via lease_id, plus the lease knots).
- Filter in `apply_index_event` / `apply_full_event`; drain on unlock.
- Remove `require_no_active_leases` from the pull path and report deferred
  knots in `SyncSummary` / `SyncOutcome`.
- Point the MCP background sync loop (src/bin/kno_mcp/sync_loop.rs:14) at the
  now-unblocked sync path.
